segments.text: I shall conclude this point with a few words of Exhortation to three sorts of men,

viz.
1. To those that never felt the power of the word.
2. To those that have only felt some slight and common effects thereof.
3. To those unto whose very hearts the Commandment is come in its effectual and saving power.

First, You that never felt any power in the word at all, I beg you in the name of him that made you, and by all the regard and value you have for those precious souls within you; that now at last such Considerations as these may find place in your souls; and that you will bethink your selves,
